hero.title: THEO STRACKE.
hero.subtitle: Front-End Developer specialized in the React and Next.js ecosystem. I build scalable, high-performance interfaces, backed by a solid foundation in Node.js and relational databases.

Scalable architecture and focus on performance

about.title: About
beats: I turn complex problems into fast, accessible digital products.
My background in enterprise technical support taught me to anticipate structural failures before they reach production.
I don't just write code: I dig deep into product rules to propose efficient solutions.
From database to interface, I work confidently across the entire delivery pipeline.

items.title: SisCeD
items.description: Scheduling and digital certificate management system built end-to-end for Rede Vellum. The application modernized internal workflows, securing how data moves through the organization and considerably cutting the time required for administrative tasks.
highlights: Modernized internal workflows with less administrative time

items.title: DespaFácil
items.description: Digital dispatch platform designed for scalability and efficiency. It features a multi-flow admin panel and JWT-based security. The Front-End was built to be highly responsive, consuming a robust REST API managed through Supabase.
highlights: Responsive Front-End consuming a REST API via Supabase

items.title: Isabelly Design
items.summary: Portfolio for a designer and marketing professional
items.description: Portfolio home page for Isabelly Vieira, a marketing, social media and design professional. The identity pairs an organic green-and-cream palette with high-contrast expanded typography and soft gradients, presenting her manifesto, areas of expertise, career path and contact in a single-page narrative.
highlights: Organic visual identity with expanded typography
Scroll-driven entrance animations with GSAP and ScrollTrigger
Smooth scrolling with Lenis and a looping brand marquee
